scope: Candidate only; no repository writes, remote calls, scorer launch, retry submission, gate/trainer change, or result recoding.
semantics: An intact native frozen scorer negative exit or TIMEOUT with parent completion and verified source/table evidence is recorded as a measured resource-bounded failure, not silently masked or recoded as missing. Only incomplete, RAISED, corrupt, or hash-invalid evidence is an audit error. A successful retry overlay remains optional and fully verified when supplied.
